tone.summary: A heavy, fuzzy stoner rock tone built around a Fuzz distortion into a Marshall-style preamp and 4x12 cabinet, emphasizing upper-mids for riff bite.

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and sustain noise inherent in heavy riffing.
Provide initial grit and boost the signal into the fuzz stage.
blocks.gap: While a dedicated Boost might be better, Green OD offers enough dirty character to start the chain.

blocks.purpose: Establish the core fuzzy stoner rock texture and thick riff drive.
Simulate the classic Marshall/Plexi crunch and power for heavy riffs.
Provide the necessary punch and character of a classic British 4x12 stack.
Boost the upper-mids for bite and compensate for potential mid-scooping from fuzz/amp.
Keep modulation minimal and subtle; useful for sustained lead parts without sounding 'lush'.
blocks.gap: Modulation is generally avoided, but a very subtle Chorus can add dimension to leads.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and sustain to lead lines without washing out the heavy riff tone.
Provide a natural sense of space for sustained notes and leads.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the current IR for a more aggressively voiced, British 4x12 to better match the stoner/hard rock genre.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Brit Cab 4x12 (e.g., Greenback or Celestion style)
proposals.reason: Enhance aggressive British crunch and upper-mid bite for stoner rock.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased punch and definition in the mids/highs
